description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的资产的数量。默认值为**10000**，表示每页显示10000条资产信息。
description.en: The number of assets to display per page in a paging query. Default value: **10000**, which indicates that up to 10,000 entries of asset information are returned per page.
The IP address of the access source.

description.zh:
指定要查询的服务器UUID列表。
> 您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID。
description.en:
The list of server UUIDs to query.
> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUIDs of servers.

title.zh: 查询暴力破解防御规则生效的服务器信息
title.en: Query servers on which brute-force attacks defense rules take effect
